name: Taimashi Izumi
source:
To save her mother abducted by ogres, Izumi comes to the enemy's safe house alone.
Can she beat strong ogres and save her mother? If she loses, she is sexually humiliated in various ways.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ031092.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]

为了拯救被食人魔绑架的母亲，泉独自来到敌人的安全屋。
她能打败强大的食人魔并拯救她的母亲吗？如果她输了，她就会受到各种方式的性羞辱。
